{{Top|fa}} {{Character |type=Bounty hunter |image=[[File:Pokkit-SC-105.png]] |name=Pokkit |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Umbaran]]{{Instagram|username=redwizard|url=p/DQsR1WAEvaB|name=[[Cristina Waltz]]|date=05-11-2025|quote=SKELETON CREW! A wild and fun Star Wars adventure where Alexei and I had the honor of heading up the prosthetics department. Our team brought a crew of alien space pirates to life straight from our workshop — and over the next week, we’ll be sharing some of our favorite characters.
First up: POKKIT, the cheeky Umbaran bounty hunter played by the brilliant Kelly MacDonald.
For this makeup, we applied a vinyl bald cap and an occipital back-of-head piece sculpted by Casey Wong and silicone appliance by Crystal Gomez. Hairstyle designed by Lane Friedman (@laneladylane) featuring a custom long-haired lace mohawk hand-tied by Alex Perrone.
Makeup application by Cristina Waltz and Gabriela Quiñonez, with help from Crystal Gomez.
Contact lens technician Diana Hansen @eskimodee More to come! #StarWars #SkeletonCrew #Prosthetics #Childrensfamilyemmys|archiveurl=https://archive.is/a2ZUc|archivefile=File:CristinaWaltz-Pokkit1-Instagram.png|archivefile2=File:CristinaWaltz-Pokkit2-Instagram.png}} |gender=[[Gender|Female]]{{SkeletonCrew|You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates}} |pronouns=She/her |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|White]] |feathers= |eyes=White |skin=White |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=[[Bounty Hunters' Guild]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|I bounty-hunt for a private client now. No more low-rent Guild jobs.''"
"''Lucky you.''"
"''So don't worry. I'm just here for some R&R. I haven't even checked the pucks.|Pokkit and Jod Na Nawood|audio=Jod-Pokkit-PrivateClient-SC5.flac|}} '''Pokkit''' was an [[Umbaran]] [[Gender|female]] [[bounty hunter]] active during the [[New Republic Era]]. Having previously worked low-rent jobs for the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild]], she began working for a private client. During a rest and relaxation visit to the [[Skull Ridge Mountain Hotel & Spa]] on the [[planet]] [[Lanupa]] around [[9 ABY]], she encountered a [[human]] that she knew as "[[Jod Na Nawood|Dash Zentin]]" who had previously stolen a [[bounty]] from her and left her in a pit of [[leech]]es. After their encounter, the bounty [[Hunting|hunter]] contacted the [[pirate]] [[Captain]] [[Brutus]], who had placed a bounty on Zentin, and provided him with Zentin's coordinates; however, Brutus refused to pay the bounty until he captured the target. Pokkit then met with the pirates Brutus sent to the [[spa]] and joined them in hunting Zentin. After the pirates captured Nawood and the [[droid]] [[SM-33]], Pokkit mocked him before the pirates escaped Lanupa with him. ==Biography== ===Left with the leeches=== {{Quote|How long has it been?''"
"''Since you stole my bounty and left me drowning in a pit of leeches?''"
"''No hard feelings? Hmm?''"
"''None whatsoever.|Jod Na Nawood and Pokkit|audio=Jod-Pokkit-Leeches-SC5.flac|}} [[File:Jod-Pokkit-SC6.png|thumb|left|300px|Pokkit encountered "Dash Zentin" in a spa on Lanupa.]] Pokkit was an [[Umbaran]] [[Gender|female]] [[bounty hunter]] who, at one stage, took low rent jobs for the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild]], although one of her [[Bounty|bounties]] was stolen by a [[human]] whom she knew as "[[Jod Na Nawood|Dash Zentin]]." After he left her in a pit of [[leech]]es, Pokkit tried to track him down, but no one she asked had ever heard of a "Dash Zentin." She later began working for a private client, and so no longer needed to take work from the Guild. During the [[New Republic Era]] around [[9 ABY]],{{SkeletonCrewDate}} Pokkit visited the [[Skull Ridge Mountain Hotel & Spa]] on the [[planet]] [[Lanupa]] for some rest and relaxation, booking a hot [[bacta]] soak. Shortly before the soak, she spotted "Zentin" at the [[spa]]'s reception desk, where he was bribing a [[Unidentified Lanupa hotelier|member of staff]] to check him in without a reservation. The human was on Lanupa [[Mission to Skull Ridge Mountain|searching]] for the [[Captain Rennod's Lair|lair]] of legendary [[pirate]] [[Captain]] [[Tak Rennod]] with a [[Skeleton Crew|group]] of [[Youngling|children]] who knew him as Jod Na Nawood. ===Dubious Dash=== {{Quote|Zentin, Silvo, whatever you call him, I'm claiming your bounty.''"
"''Where is the cowardly wretch?''"
"''Here is the coordinates. Now how about my payment?''"
"''You'll have your payment when I have Silvo. I'm sending two ships.|Pokkit and Brutus|audio=Pokkit-Brutus-SC5.flac|}} Pokkit approached Na Nawood, who greeted her in a friendly fashion but only remembered the first half of her name. The bounty [[Hunting|hunter]] reminded him of the nature of their last encounter but claimed there was no bad blood between them, although she also brought up the failed search for anyone with the name "Dash Zentin." After mentioning her client, Pokkit then informed Na Nawood that she had not even checked the [[Holopuck|bounty pucks]] during her visit and so he had no need to worry, although as she left for the bacta soak, she warned Na Nawood's child companions not to trust him. [[File:Brutus-Pokkit-SC5.png|thumb|right|300px|Pokkit contacted Brutus about the bounty on Na Nawood.]] Pokkit then discovered that there was a bounty on Na Nawood's head posted by his former pirate [[Silvo's pirates|crew]], who had mutinied against him while he used the name "Captain Silvo." She contacted their new captain, [[Brutus]], via [[hologram]] in one of the spa's [[hotel]] rooms{{SkeletonCrew|You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates}} {{AD|Disney+}} and provided him with Na Nawood's coordinates; however, Brutus refused to pay her until he had taken Na Nawood captive. He informed the bounty hunter that he would be sending [[Unidentified pirate transport 1|two]] [[Unidentified pirate transport 2|ships]] of pirates to apprehend Na Nawood and ordered her to tell no one about it, which Pokkit agreed to. ===Pokkit and the pirates=== {{Quote|No hard feelings, Dash. It really has been wonderful running into you.|Pokkit mocks Jod Na Nawood|audio=Pokkit-SC6.flac|{{SkeletonCrew|Zero Friends Again}}}} [[File:PokkitAndPirates-Getty.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Pokkit worked with Brutus's pirates on Lanupa.]] Once the pirates arrived at the spa, Pokkit joined them in hunting Na Nawood. The bounty and his child allies had headed into tunnels beneath the spa where Rennod's lair was located and were also being pursued by the spa's security. Pokkit and the pirates came across several [[Security guard|guards]] in the tunnels and took two [[Prisoner|captive]] while the pirate [[Gunter]] shot and [[Death|killed]] a [[Unidentified Lanupa security grunt|third]]. They then reached a chamber where Na Nawood had drained a pool of [[acid]] to reach the entrance to the lair. As they opened fire on Na Nawood, he sealed the entrance behind him and refilled the pool with acid. When Na Nawood later emerged from the lair back into the spa—without the children and hauling large amounts of treasure—Pokkit and the pirates were waiting for him. As the pirate [[Beef]] and a [[Weequay]] grabbed Na Nawood and disarmed him, Pokkit smiled and waved at her bounty. Na Nawood's [[droid]] [[SM-33]] also emerged from the lair but was immediately [[stun]]ned by an [[Ion cannon|ion]] blast, and the pirates began marching Na Nawood toward their [[starship]]. As he moved, Pokkit threw an [[Limb|arm]] around him and mockingly claimed it had been good running into him again, giving him a kiss on the cheek. [[New Republic]] [[X-wing starfighter]]s then arrived at the spa, causing the pirates to scramble and rush back to their ship with Na Nawood and SM-33. One of the pirate's vessels was destroyed by the [[starfighter]]s, but the remaining pirates escaped. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|No, no, no, no, no. Listen, that nice lady is a ruthless bounty hunter with a bad grudge. Most likely she's already called my name in.|Jod Na Nawood|audio=Jod-NiceLady-SC5.flac|}} [[File:Pokkit-SWCT.png|thumb|200px|right|Pokkit wore a mostly black outfit which contrasted with her white skin, hair, and eyes.]] A charismatic individual,{{Topps|set=2025 Topps Star Wars Chrome|cardname=#97 - Pokkit|link=https://www.ebay.com/itm/297574164036}} Pokkit had a grudge against Jod Na Nawood, who described her as lovely but ruthless. She had pale [[Color|white]] [[eye]]s, white [[hair]], and chalky white skin. She spoke with a harsher form of the clipped [[Language|accent]] commonly found in the [[Core Worlds]].In "[[You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates]]," Pokkit speaks with the same accent as [[Bala-Tik]] uses in {{Film|VII}}. ''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'' identifies this accent as a harsher form of the clipped [[Language|accent]] commonly found in the [[Core Worlds]]. ==Equipment== At the spa, Pokkit wore a mostly black [[Clothing|outfit]] including a wrist [[comlink]], fingerless [[glove]]s, black [[boot]]s, and a brown [[belt]] with a pair of [[stuncuffs]] and a [[holster]]ed [[blaster pistol]] on it. She also wore the white and purple floral neckwear granted to the spa guests on arrival. ==Behind the scenes== Pokkit was portrayed by [[Kelly Macdonald]] in the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'', first appearing in the fifth episode, "[[You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates]]," which aired on [[December 24]], [[2024]].{{Twitter|starwars|status/1861409832349172011|''[[Star Wars]]''|date=2024-11-26|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/uxgSx|archivefile=File:StarWars-SkeletonCrewSchedule-Twitter.png}} Concept artist [[Patrick Beals]] created two designs for Pokkit's wrist comlink{{ArtStation|username=pbeals|url=artwork/1Ny2eq|name=[[Patrick Beals]]|text=Pokkit's Wrist Comlink|date=2025-12-01|quote=Here are a couple designs for the bounty hunter character Pokkit, on vacation on the planet Lanupa. The top version of the comlink has some elements from some wrist devices seen on Lando and Princess Leia from Return of the Jedi, while the bottom one is an original design. The bottom (orange) one was ultimately selected. The reason the tattoos and skin look different on the two renders was that this was when I switched my workflow over to rendering in Blender from Keyshot. Design direction by Doug Chiang. Property Master: Steven Melton}} and one for her stuncuffs, with [[Doug Chiang]] providing design direction and [[Steven B. Melton|Steven Melton]] acting as property master.{{ArtStation|username=pbeals|url=artwork/DLXwZA|name=[[Patrick Beals]]|text=Pokkit's Binders|date=2025-12-01|quote=These were handcuffs for the bounty hunter character Pokkit to dangle and menace the character Jod/Silvio in the lobby of the fancy Hutt hotel on Lanupa. They were simple and quick and weren't really meant to work. I incorporated some of the model kit parts ILM used on some of the classic spaceship models from the original Star Wars films. Design direction by Doug Chiang Property Master: Steven Melton}} One of the comlink designs was based on wrist devices worn by the characters [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] in the film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], but Beals' second design, which was an original, was selected instead. The binders were a simple and quick design that was not intended to function but to act as a prop that Pokkit could dangle in front of Silvo to menace him. They incorporated model kit parts that [[Industrial Light & Magic]] used on some of the starship models in the [[original trilogy]]. The character's makeup was done by [[Cristina Waltz]] and [[Alexei Dmitriew]]'s prosthetic makeup team and included a vinyl bald cap and an occipital piece sculpted by [[Casey Jay Wong]] and a silicone appliance created by [[Crystal Gomez]]. [[Lane Friedman]] designed Pokkit's hairstyle, which included a custom-made long-haired lace mohawk that was hand-tied by [[Alex Perrone]]. Waltz and [[Ana Gabriela Quiñonez Urrego]] applied the character's makeup with help from Gomez and [[Diana Hansen]] acted as her contact lens technician. Although Pokkit's [[species]] is not specified in the series, Waltz confirmed the character is an Umbaran on [[Wikipedia:Instagram|Instagram]]. ===Concept art gallery=== {{Gallery |source=''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'' |storyboards= |concept= File:PokkitsWristComlink-ArtStation.png|Pokkit's Wrist Comlink, [[Patrick Beals]] File:PokkitsBinders-ArtStation.png|Pokkit's Binders, Patrick Beals |digital= |in-progress= }} ==Appearances== *{{SkeletonCrew|You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates}} {{1st}} *{{SkeletonCrew|Zero Friends Again}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/skeleton-crew/season-1-episode-5-episode-guide|text="You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates" Episode Guide | Star Wars: Skeleton Crew}} *{{SW|url=news/skeleton-crew-highlights-105|text=''Skeleton Crew'' Explained | Highlights from 105 "You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates"}} {{Imo}} *{{ThisWeek|VLHkqJLIftk|Dispatch: Skull Ridge Mountain Looks Different}} *{{SW|url=series/skeleton-crew/season-1-episode-6-episode-guide|text="Zero Friends Again" Episode Guide | Star Wars: Skeleton Crew}} {{Po}} *{{SW|url=news/skeleton-crew-highlights-106|text=''Skeleton Crew'' Explained | Episode 6 - "Zero Friends Again"}} {{Po}} *{{ThisWeek|-uzR9vkPgrM|Dispatch: Leaving Lanupa}} *{{SWYouTube|SBFoAS156lQ|Skeleton Crew | Official Clip | Episode 6 Now Streaming on Disney+}} *{{SW|url=news/skeleton-crew-monkey-island-art-steve-purcell|text=The Secrets of ''Star Wars: Skeleton Crew's Monkey Island''-Inspired Poster Art}} *{{Topps|set=2025 Topps Star Wars Chrome|cardname=#97 - Pokkit|link=https://www.ebay.com/itm/297574164036}} *{{Databank|pokkit|Pokkit}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Pokkit|imagecat=Images of Pokkit}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ja=ポキット |ka=პოკიტი }} [[Category:Bounty Hunters' Guild bounty hunters]] [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Individuals with she/her pronouns]] [[Category:Umbarans]]
